title: Printing Values
concept: Combine io.println with string.format1 to print variables alongside text.
why: Printing static text is limited. To show dynamic values, you need to embed variables in your output.
syntax_ref:
use xiom.string;
string.format1("text {} more text", variable);
tips: `use xiom.string;` must come before you call string functions
`{}` inside the format string is the placeholder
`format1` takes one value; `format2` takes two values
Without `use xiom.string;`, string functions won't be available
common_mistakes: Forgetting `use xiom.string;` at the top of the file
Using `{name}` instead of `{}` — XIOM uses simple placeholders
Trying to print an Int with format1 — convert it or use string concatenation
